forecasts.reference-class: Exit of a sitting Iran Supreme Leader within a near-term horizon (before April 1, 2026) under Iran's constitutional succession framework, as estimated by prediction markets and accompanied by expert analyses of the Assembly of Experts and IRGC influence.

sources.claim: Kalshi markets indicate he is more likely than not to step down in 2026, with a 56% chance of being out of power before July and a 64% chance before September 2026.
Polymarket traders assign a 34% probability that Khamenei will no longer hold the position by June 30, 2026.
Washington Post explains the succession process and how the Assembly of Experts will select a new leader.
Los Angeles Times explains the succession process and interim arrangements if the leader dies.
The National discusses potential contenders and the role of the IRGC in a succession scenario.
Kalshi markets (Jan 13, 2026) show a 56% chance Ali Khamenei will be out of power before July 2026 and a 64% chance by September 2026.
Kalshi's market as of Feb 28, 2026 prices abolition of the post at 49%, Hassan Khomeini 24%, Mojtaba Khamenei 14%.
Polymarket odds on naming a successor by March 2 are around 43%, with around 81% by March 31.
Value The Markets (Jan 13, 2026) reports odds of departure by end of 2026 around 65%; with 46% by March 31 and 53% by June 30.
Washington Post reports that Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is dead at 86, as of February 28, 2026.
Associated Press confirms death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei (age 86) on February 28, 2026.
The Guardian reports Iranian state media says Khamenei was killed in US-Israeli strikes; 40 days of mourning announced.
Al Jazeera reports Iran confirms the death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei after US-Israeli attacks.
Time reports that Khamenei was killed in a joint US-Israeli attack.
